YOUR ADVENTURE GUIDE

How to Play

Start in Genesis and follow the journey through Bible history. Each solved word reveals an original scene from the account.

Make words: Glide across the circular letters or tap them in order. Use Hint when you need a nudge.

Explore: Journey shows the animated timeline. Levels lists Bible books and the episodes you've unlocked.

Only the first two Genesis discoveries are playable in this preview. Other chapters unlock as we complete and release them.
